name: Payments
description: Money taken for an order. The processor is an organization in the parties vocabulary, not a domain of its own.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: Money authorized, captured, or refunded against an order. Amount and currency are two attributes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The states of a payment. Capture and refund are behavior.

attributes.name: processor
attributes.description: The firm that handles the payment. An instance of organization, such as Northwind Pay.

relationships.name: issues
relationships.description: An organization issues the payment. Which firm is the processor is an instance, not a new entity.
